notes.note: Reviewed the tool-update supervisor change: a failed ACP tool call's error now falls back to rawOutput (string, or an error/message/stderr/output field, else compact JSON) when content is absent, and otherwise states that the engine gave no reason. The guide makes no claim about failed-call error text, and its runtime.error and Kiro Internal-error sections are unaffected; no prose change. Checked with acp-tool-update-supervisor and acp-adapter-events focused tests, including a revert that failed the new cases. Limit: the Antigravity rawOutput shape is inferred; recorded nightly events kept no raw frames.
